summary.zh: 用命令行管理 Gmail、Drive 和日历
summary.en: Manage Gmail, Drive and Calendar from the CLI

description.zh: 通过 gws 命令行操作 Gmail、Drive、Sheets、Calendar、Docs、Chat 和 Tasks，自带授权引导、环境诊断、常用任务配方和安全审计。适合批量处理邮件、文件与日程。需要先完成 Google 账号授权。
description.en: Runs Workspace tasks from the gws command line across Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Calendar, Docs and Tasks, with auth setup, diagnostics, recipes and a security audit. Good for bulk mail and file work. Google authorization comes first.
